content.text: Similar Products You May Like: Product DetailsSpecificationsShipping FAQThe Kraken stands as one of the most fearsome figures in maritime legend, originating primarily in Scandinavian lore as a monstrous, squid-like sea creature of unbelievable size and strength. Said to pull entire ships beneath the ocean with its enormous, spiraling tentacles, this mythical beast has captured imaginations for centuries. Now, the 3 oz Antique Finish Kraken Silver Statue available online from JM Bullion. Statue Highlights: Statues arrives in a standard box with a Certificate of Authenticity! Showcases the legendary Kraken! Produced by Gold Spartan! Hand-poured silver! Finished with an antique patina! Limited casting of only 100 pieces! Contains 3 Troy oz of .9999 pure silver. Features the Kraken’s immense frame and sprawling limbs. Includes laser-engraved serial numbers and hallmarks on each piece. Please note: each statue may vary in weight up to .2 up or down from the listed weight; all COA weights will match that listed on the statue. The design of the 3 oz Antique Finish Kraken Silver Statue presents a powerful interpretation of the Kraken in sculptural form. Historical lore often depicts the creature as an enormous sea beast with a tangle of seemingly endless tentacles reaching out in all directions. Every one of these statues is individually hand-poured, resulting in subtle variations in texture and shape—making each one a truly one-of-a-kind addition to any collection. In modern popular culture, the Kraken has been reinvented numerous times, most notably in cinema where it frequently appears as an antagonist summoned by maritime villains or vengeful deities. While these depictions often bear little resemblance to the original Norse creature, they maintain its essential characteristics as an unstoppable force of nature symbolizing the ocean’s unpredictability and danger. These 3 oz Antique Finish Kraken Silver Statues from Gold Spartan arrive in a standard shipping box and include a Certificate of Authenticity. The statue’s antique finish offers a timeworn, heirloom-like appearance, while the laser-engraved serial number and hallmark on every piece verify its authenticity and place in the limited release.
